topic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
source_evidence: Every time you use a credit card, track how much you have spent and figure out how much you’ll have to pay that month.
answer: To keep credit card spending visible, record how much you spend each time you use the card and keep a running total of what you’ll owe that month. If you expect you cannot pay the full balance, work out how much you can pay each month and how long it may take to clear the balance. Tracking helps you understand what you owe and plan your payments.
